justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/matcher/CollectionErasureMatcher.java, byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/matcher/ElementMatchers.java, and byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/matcher/CollectionErasureMatcherTest.java. The class is a thin adapter: it has one collaborator field (matcher), one short doMatch loop that only converts TypeDefinition items to erasures, and its only production instantiation is in ElementMatchers.erasures(...). I found no evidence of broad fan-in or fan-out beyond that single factory call and the test, so it is not a dependency hub.
